name: SENS
description: Supply Chain (SC) modeling is essential to understand and influence SC behavior, especially for increasingly globalized and complex SCs. Existing models address various SC notions, e.g., processes, tiers and production, in an isolated manner limiting enriched analysis granted by integrated information systems. Moreover, the scarcity of real-world data prevents the benchmarking of the overall SC performance in different circumstances, especially wrt. resilience during disruption. We present SENS, an ontology-based Knowlegde-Graph (KG) equipped with SPARQL implementations of KPIs to incorporate an end-to-end perspective of the SC including standardized SCOR processes and metrics. Further, we propose SENS-GEN, a highly configurable data generator that leverages SENS to create synthetic semantic SC data under multiple scenario configurations for comprehensive analysis and benchmarking applications.
